title: T01 - The padlock does not mean safe
source_words: tests/inputs/T01_tech_short.md (phrase-start times; word times inside a phrase are estimated where marked est)

beats.label: what the lock really means: the line is encrypted
nobody in the middle can read it
but the site itself can be a scam
most phishing sites have the padlock too
check the address, not the lock
lock and all - loop to the first frame

camera.reason: on 'in your browser?' show that the lock sits in an address bar; the address text stays blurred because the answer is hidden until 21.0

subject_motion.what: lock scales 0.92 -> 1.0, ease back.out(1.4) - the hook image lands on frame 1
teal lock left of centre, '≠' strikes in (scale 1.3 -> 1.0, 0.2 s) on 'NOT'
word SAFE fades up right of '≠' on 'safe', neutral grey (not green: the lock did not earn green)

shots.subject: you-site diagram

subject_motion.what: YOU (phone icon, bottom, y 1450) and SITE (box, top, y 470) fade up with small labels
line draws bottom -> top from YOU to SITE, ease sine.inOut (follows 'the line between you and the site')
line thickens into a teal tube; the padlock flies from the top-left corner and docks on the tube middle (the lock belongs to the LINE)

shots.transition_out: hard cut (match cut, same axis, size step WS -> CU)

subject_motion.what: scrambled glyph packets flow bottom -> top inside the tube, 2 packets/s
red eavesdropper eye icon slides in from screen-right, stops 120 px from the tube
eye icon shows a red '?' - it sees traffic pass but cannot read it
site box fills the safe area: a clean, friendly shop page; tube end and teal lock visible at bottom edge, still teal
on 'scam' the shop page drops like a mask (y +60 px, opacity 1 -> 0, ease power2.in); red interior with a fish-hook icon
hold; teal lock at bottom stays teal - the lock was right, the site is wrong

camera.amount: scale 3.0 -> 1.0, focus point card 5 (380,820) -> grid centre (540,960)
camera.reason: the one scam card becomes one of twelve: 'most phishing sites' is a quantity, and only a widening frame shows quantity

subject_motion.what: on 'padlock too' all 12 card locks flash teal at the same frame (scale 1.0 -> 1.25 -> 1.0) - peak of the video

subject_motion.trigger: red envelope enters the stamp (edit: place on 'free', about 19.9 est)
subject_motion.what: the stamp hits the red envelope exactly as it hits the cream ones

focus.reason: the line says 'check the address': attention moves from the lock to the address without moving the frame
focus.fallback: native in 2D: blur lock 0 -> 6 px, address 8 -> 0 px

subject_motion.what: address 'kestrelbank.com' turns amber (first amber of the video)
on 'not the lock' the lock dims to 35% opacity
label 'REAL BANK' + green tick fade up above the bar

shots.subject: real vs fake bars

camera.reason: on 'Lock and all' look hard at the lock on the fake site; the end frame repeats the first frame of S01 so the Short loops

subject_motion.what: fake bar 'kestrelbanc.com' with lock slides in from screen-right under the real bar
the 'c' turns red with a red underline; the real 'k' gets an amber underline

shots.transition_out: loop to S01 (end frame = S01 frame 1 composition)

music_hints.hint: start on frame 1, no intro; light pulse
accent on 'padlock too' (all locks flash) - the peak
